# Changelog

## [0.2.0](https://github.com/ZenRows/zenrows-integrations/compare/copilot-v0.1.1...copilot-v0.2.0) (2026-11-20)


### Features

* **copilot:** The plugin description in `plugin.json`, the README intro and the opening of the `using-zenrows` skill now say in full what Zenrows does: fetch any public page as Markdown, HTML or text, pull structured fields as JSON, run batch jobs, crawl a site from one start URL and drive a hosted browser, with proxies, JavaScript rendering and anti-bot protection handled by Zenrows. ([b9beeb8](https://github.com/ZenRows/zenrows-integrations/commit/b9beeb8250096173c857f3560861280e9c2fc5f5))
* **copilot:** The README links the Zenrows MCP server documentation (docs.zenrows.com/mcp/overview). ([b9beeb8](https://github.com/ZenRows/zenrows-integrations/commit/b9beeb8250096173c857f3560861280e9c2fc5f5))
* **monid:** Zenrows connector for Monid, as a code host ([#20](https://github.com/ZenRows/zenrows-integrations/issues/20)) ([bd65d61](https://github.com/ZenRows/zenrows-integrations/commit/bd65d610be811762a87dbbf03043f40df75cb267))
